title: Bikcraft
description: A modern and responsive portfolio website with dark mode support.
longDescription: Web application developed with focus on responsiveness, accessibility, and user experience, including dark mode support, detailed project pages, JavaScript animations, and optimized structure for performance and SEO.

title: Sandlerflix
description: A project fully dedicated to Adam Sandler.
longDescription: Responsive frontend project dedicated exclusively to Adam Sandler's filmography, with adaptable layout for multiple devices, dynamic content organization, and focus on performance and usability.

title: 42 Porto
description: Projects developed during the 42 Porto Common Core.
longDescription: Repository centralizing projects developed during 42 Porto's Common Core, covering C programming exercises, Shell Script, and logic challenges, with emphasis on low-level programming, memory management, and terminal automation.

title: Budget App
description: A budget app created for Stock Som and Stock Music stores, with automatic date updates and print.
longDescription: Custom budget generation system for Stock Som and Stock Music stores, with automatic date updates, record duplication for clients, document generation for printing, and optimized commercial workflow.

title: Spotify Clone
description: Spotify interface clone using CSS and JS effects.
longDescription: Functional clone of Spotify interface, developed for educational purposes, with responsive layout, simulated music player, dynamic interactions via JavaScript, and advanced CSS styling.

title: Fokus App
description: An app to manage focus and optimize productivity using Pomodoro method.
longDescription: Productivity application based on Pomodoro technique, allowing task management, focus cycles and breaks control, and daily performance tracking through timers and persistent states.

title: Green Loop
description: Hackathon project 'The Retail Hack' against food waste.
longDescription: Project developed in 'The Retail Hack' hackathon promoted by Grupo Sonae and Google, focusing on reducing food waste through identifying near-expiry products, displaying discounts, and geolocation in stores.

title: Eri Pongson - v2
description: Pong game with AI, inspired by actor Eri Johnson, improving gameplay and animations.
longDescription: Pong-style game developed with Artificial Intelligence to control the opponent, with significant physics improvements, smoother animations, difficulty balancing, and performance optimization in the second version.

title: Notes App
description: A note-taking app with TypeScript/JS support for text or audio notes.
longDescription: Notes management application developed in TypeScript and JavaScript, supporting text and audio records, dynamic content organization, data persistence, and intuitive productivity-oriented interface.

title: Secret Number Game
description: A guessing game that tracks the number of attempts to make it competitive.
longDescription: Logic-based number guessing game where the system generates a secret number and counts user attempts, stimulating logical reasoning, state control, and dynamic interface interaction.

title: Encryptor
description: Encryptor allowing to copy encrypted text or reverse the process.
longDescription: Text encryption and decryption application implemented in JavaScript, enabling secure message transformation, reversal of the process, automated result copying, and data integrity validation.
